scope: matched native VT Unicode scalar-property caching and bounded wide repairs; excludes rendering and physical input latency
method: Randomized paired AkiTTY/Ghostty order. Every sample compares active/history text, widths, styles, wrapping and cursor metadata after feeding and after narrow/restore resize. Rates use p50 feed time; resize is verified but excluded from throughput.

pty.configuration: 8 MiB fixtures, three warmups and 11 samples; actual native worker/model, grapheme defaults; excludes rendering
pty.note: The reported repeat has a stable p50; the discarded attempt contained multi-second scheduling outliers, especially in Unicode. No PTY improvement is claimed.

qualifications: Direct comparisons use libghostty-vt 1.0.1 only in the local benchmark executable.
All direct feed and resize state comparisons passed.
Canonical native/WASM final state summaries agree.
PTY rates cover transport and model work, not snapshots, rendering or physical input latency.
The local Ghostty source snapshot was reviewed for ideas only; no source was copied or linked into AkiTTY.
